summary_en: Takara Holdings raised its FY2027 dividend forecast to 34 yen per share from 31 yen, reflecting upward revision of net profit guidance to 17.4 billion yen from 11.9 billion yen. The increase aligns with the company's progressive dividend policy and 50% cumulative payout ratio target.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Consolidated Financial Performance Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Takara Holdings announced an upward revision of its dividend forecast for fiscal year 2027 (ending March 31, 2027). The company increased its annual dividend per share from the previously forecast 31 yen to 34 yen per share, reflecting a significant upward revision of consolidated earnings guidance.

The company raised its net income attributable to parent company shareholders from 11.9 billion yen to 17.4 billion yen, a 46.2% increase. This upward earnings revision was driven by better-than-expected performance in the Takara Sake segment, where shochu sales increased, and strong continued performance in the Takara International group's overseas alcohol beverage and food distribution businesses. While the Takara Bio group faced headwinds from global life sciences market weakness, the company's overall performance exceeded previous forecasts.

The dividend increase aligns with the company's "Takara Group Medium-Term Management Plan 2030," which introduced a progressive dividend policy targeting a cumulative payout ratio of 50% over five years. The company stated that the revised dividend forecast reflects both this stated shareholder return policy and the upward earnings revision.
